title.narrative: CIVIC Protection of Civilians, Reversing the Trend: Putting Civilians First 2023

description.narrative:
A significant reduction in conflict-related civilian harm:
-Conflict-affected civilians bring about improved protection for their communities -Governments and armed actors implement effective strategies and best practices on the protection of civilians -Multinational bodies and coalitions take action to protect civilians from harm -Civil society exerts greater pressure on governments and armed actors to protect civilians and take responsibility for the harm they cause
Conflict-affected civilians along the Kenya-Somalia border, the DRC, South Sudan, Mali, CAR, and Yemen
Partnership with the Netherlands Ministry of Foreign Affairs towards the goal of a significant reduction in conflict-related civilian harm
